name: Marimo Pants
summary: A real-time soccer simulator role-playing game, its system is similar to the Famicom version of Captain Tsubasa, with a tragic story about a girl with a unique physical condition. The protagonists play a sport called “Sokkaa,” whose goal is to entertain the spectators. Since the system gives an advantage to whoever gets the crowd more excited, the matches become a back-and-forth exchange of flashy special moves.
